title: modified statistical-based value at risk for multi-objective optimal-based portfolio analysis of indonesian stock return distribution
core_idea: Modify the calculation of value at risk (VaR) to incorporate skewness and kurtosis so the normality assumption is not required, and use multi-objective optimization to construct risk-averse portfolios that can be adjusted to investor risk profiles and stabilize mean return for non-normally distributed Indonesian stock returns.
tldr: Introduce a modified VaR using skewness and kurtosis and apply multi-objective optimization to create adjustable, risk-averse portfolios for Indonesian blue-chip stocks with non-normal return distributions.
